g.text: Figure 6 | Regional LFADS prediction saturates at compact ranks within one session

text.style: font-size: 8.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #56616f

g.text: Binish et al. Figures 3–4 adapted to M1, M2 and S1; all downstream models use complete-trial folds and the archive's actual 38 LFADS factors.

a, For each undirected cortical pair, points are the ranks selected inside training data by the one-standard-error rule from both directions across five complete-trial folds; the rank-38 reference is shown descriptively and is not a statistical comparator because selected rank is

bounded by construction. b, Outer-test residual-population R² is shown as predictive LFADS dimensions are added for all three targets from each source; triangles mark rank-38 fits. Regional LFADS factors were archived without their original encoder split, so these panels do not
establish native LFADS generalization, anatomy or causality.
